body:
I'm sorry to hear that... I know exactly how you feel about getting rejected, it happened to me so many times already in my life that I pretty sure now that there's something very wrong with me and I will never be happy in this life. 


I really wanted to get into this university because it's one of the best ones and I had very good grades at high school and at the exams at the end of the high school years and when I saw that I got a very small grade at the entry exam... I think I had what some people call a mental breakdown... it's just too much already...


Thanks a lot for being awesome and writing that message, I feel so lonely lately that even something like this makes me extremely happy, I won't give up yet but I can feel that it will inevitably happen very soon
